translated_title: Dialogue Between Lutnick and President Sheinbaum Will Be Useful in Trade Negotiations, Ebrard Says
original_title: Diálogo entre Lutnick y la presidenta Sheinbaum será de utilidad en negociación comercial: Ebrard
author: Alejandro Alegría
meta_description: Economy Secretary Marcelo Ebrard called the U.S. commerce chief’s meeting with Sheinbaum cordial as both countries prepare a fourth round of USMCA review talks this month.
